translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

book.name: Gálatas
book.title: Galaciagi Gwenadgan-Bukmaladse Pablo Garda Narmaksad Gálatas

content: Ani Pablo, Bab-Jesús-nuggi-barmilealidid, an dulemar-nuggi barmilealidsulid, dulemar gwen an-nug-imaksasulid. Jesucristo, degine, Bab-Dummad-anmar-Baba Jesucristo-burgwar-maigusad-odulosad, amar an-nug-imaksad.
Ani Pablo, degine, bela gwenadgan-anba-gudimalad, bemar Bab-Jesúsba-nanaimalad-danar-ambikunoni-damalad Galacia-yargi-bukmaladse anmar garda narmaksiid.
Bab Dummad anmar-Baba, degi, anmar-Dummad-Jesucristo, amar bitigi bemargi nued binsamalana-gadin, degine, ulubgi bogidik bemar-itogega imakbalina-yerban.
A-Jesucristo anmar-iskued-ular burgwega na san uksad, Bab Dummad anmar-Baba, a-sogedba, adi emi-ibagangi ibmar-iskana-nanaidgi anmar mer bar eba ebipiledii-gumalagar.
Degisoggu, degi-sadegu Bab-Dummad-nug ogannomarsun. Ar deyobdo.
Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-nued unnila gwennaa gued
Cristogi bemar abonolege-wilubsulinad, degite, Bab Dummad bemarse gochad Cristogi bemar abonolegegar. An geger be-dakmardo, ibiyobi gwae-gwae agi bemar bangudmala, abonoleged-igar-baidba naegar.
Ar soglesurdo, igar-baid sunna dule-abonoged nika-deeye. Suli, nika suli. Ar ade unnila bemar-binsaed-gaega gudidimalad, degine, Cristogi-abonoleged-igar oburdimalad.
Ani an Pablo, an-sunnad-dibe, igi, anger-nibneggined-wargwen-dibe, Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-nuedgi an bemar-odurdaksadba akar bemarga igar-ukalile, we-dule Bab Dummadse sabsur odurdaklegena-gadin.

Ar igi bato an bemarga sogsa, emigi gannar an bemarga sogbar, ar dule-wargwen Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-nued sunna dule-abonoged-igargi an be-odurdaksamaladba akar bemar-odurdakalile, we-dule, Bab Dummadse sabsur odurdaklegena-gadin.

Bemar insagua, ¿dulemar-nabir-ito-saed an amidii be insae, igi, unnila Bab-Dummad-nabir-ito-saedi an amidii? Dulemar-yeer-ito-imakedgi an binsadisulid, ar dulemar-yeer-ito-saed amba an amidiile, ar an Cristoga-arbaed-dulesurdo.
Pablo Bab-Jesús-igargi arbasad
Gwenadgan, bemar nue wisgubi an be-abemardo, Bab-Jesúsgi-abonoleged-igargi an bemarga sunmaksadi, we-igar dulemar onossulid.
Ar dulemar Bab-Jesús-igargi gwen an-odurdaksasulid, degine, dulemar we-igar anga uksasurbalid. Jesucristo-sunnad we-igar osanalos anga uksad.

Ar bato bemar an-wismalad, epenne igi Judiomar-igar-maidba an nanadigusa. Bab-Jesúsba-nanaimalad-danar-ambikunoni-damalad ise-baregindii an gusad, degine, bela amar-osulogegala an sabsur amar-imakdii-gusad.
Degine, Judiomar-igar-mamaidgi an-sordamar an-un-sergumaladba an-bur-bule aimargi obin-gusad, ar ade an-bur-bule an-dadgan-igar-mamaidba an daed.
Ar Bab Dummad na nabir-itogedba, amba an-sapi-ibe-neggi-an-mai, an-susad, ar Bab Dummad nabir angi binsae-wilubsulinad, degite anse gochad, an-abonogegar.
Bab Dummad na E-Machi angi oyogegala imaknonikid, adi Judiosurmaladga an E-Machigi sunmakegar. We degi-gusadi, dulemarse gwen an idaksasulid.

Degine, Jerusalén-neggweburse gwen an arbisurbalid, an-iduar Bab-Jesús-nuggi-barmilearmalad-bukmaladse igar-amiegar. Suli, degisuli. Arabia-yarse bur an nade-gusad, geb degi gannar Damascose an noni-gusbalid.
A-birgapaagwad-sorba geb Jerusalénse an nade-gusad, Pedro-dakegar. Pedro-walik ibambe-gakatar an megialid.
Agine, Bab-Jesús-nuggi-barmilearmalad baigan gwen an daksasulid, unnila Santiagobi an daksa, Bab-Jesús-e-urba.
We an bemarga an narmaksiidi, Bab-Dummad-asabin, napiragwad an bemarga soged, an gakansasulid.
Geb a-sorba an Siria-yalaganba an nade-gusad, degi, Cilicia-yalaganba.
Cristoba-nanaimalad-danar-ambikunoni-damalad Judea-yalagangi-bukmaladdi, gwen an-dakdisurmalad, aku an-dakmalad.
A-dulemar unnila sunmak itomalad: “We-dule, epenne anmar-baregindii-daedi, emigindi Bab-Jesús-bensulid-igargi sunmakdiiye, epennedi unnila Jesús-igar-osulogedgi-binsadii-daeddeye.”
Degisoggu, we-gwenadgan an-nuggi Bab-Dummad-e-nug odummodmarsunnad.
